jd_file: The Hong Kong Jockey Club IT Operations Leadership
role_summary: Lead the transformation of IT Service Operations by adopting SRE principles, automating manual processes, and fostering a DevOps culture within a 24/7 high-availability wagering environment.
must_have_requirements: 15+ years experience in IT Operations with 8+ years in leadership positions
Proven track record managing high-availability, high-transaction systems
Deep expertise in SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) and DevOps methodology
Experience in incident response management for mission-critical IT platforms
Strong background in cloud-native architecture and containerization
Experience managing distributed support teams (L1-L2) and stakeholder engagement
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience in wagering, gaming, or large-scale fintech industry
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipeline integration
Expertise in modern observability and monitoring tools
Professional certification in ITIL or SRE methodologies

scoring_criteria.name: Experience Level
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requires senior-level maturity to handle high-stakes racing/wagering infrastructure.

scoring_criteria.name: SRE/DevOps Transformation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core mission is converting manual operations to SRE/DevOps models.

scoring_criteria.name: High Availability Infrastructure
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Platform uptime is critical for the Club's revenue and regulatory compliance.

scoring_criteria.name: Incident & Release Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must maintain stability while improving release velocity.

scoring_criteria.name: Cloud/Containerization Competency
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Necessary for modern scalable wagering operations.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder & Change Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role bridges Business Lines, IT, and external vendors.

scoring_criteria.name: Operational Efficiency/Automation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Target is to replace manual routine upkeep with automated scripts.

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership Style & Culture
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must align with the Club's Ignition culture and foster accountability.

summary_focus: Emphasize long-term leadership in high-availability environments and successful IT transformation programs.
do_not_overclaim: Ensure tool-specific expertise (e.g., Kubernetes, Observability) is framed through operational impact rather than just list accumulation.

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Align as a proven change agent who balances high-stakes technical rigor with empathy for the human element of IT teams.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If lacking specific wagering sector experience, focus on the scale of your transaction-heavy environments in fintech or e-commerce.
